statCard.name: The Blob
statCard.artist: Patrick Brown, Gare Daniels III & Alex Trip

attacks.name: Strike
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains |!power| equal to the |!damage| dealt.
|!wild| |*Push|: After this attack is resolved, if the defender is |!size| 3 or less, this character may Push it Away |!range_small|.

attacks.name: Thunderous Splash
steps: Before |!damage| is dealt, Place this character within |!range| 1 of the defender.

|!wild| |*Explosive Force|: After this attack is resolved, other characters within |!range| 2 of this character are Pushed Away from this character |!range_small|. Characters Pushed this way suffer 1 |!damage|.

superPowers.name: Catch Little Man!
superPowers.body: Choose an interactive terrain feature of |!size| 3 or less within |!range| 2 and Throw it |!range_medium|. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Ha, Ha, Ha, That Tickles!
superPowers.body: If this character would suffer |!damage| from an attack, it may use this superpower. Reduce the amount of |!damage| suffered by 1 to a minimum of 1. After the attack is resolved, if the attacker is within |!range| 3 of this character, this character may Push it Away |!range_small|.

superPowers.name: Nothing Can Move The Blob!
superPowers.body: This character cannot be Pushed or Thrown as a result of attack special rules.
